label: Symbolic Scene Fact Schema
description: Reusable Prolog-oriented scene representation extracted from the legacy ARC3 object prompt.
text: For each meaningful visual object, emit only evidence-supported symbolic facts.

The preferred vocabulary includes object/3, color/2, colors/2, bbox/5, size/3, area/2, occupied_cells/2, cell_runs/2, shape/2, orientation/2, component_of/2, contains/2, inside/2, adjacent/2, touches/2, overlaps/2, aligned_with/3, symmetry/2, role/2, and confidence/2.
Prefer compact cell_runs/2 over exhaustive occupied_cells/2 for large regular regions, while preserving exact irregular topology and holes.
Keep current-state scene facts separate from transition observations and rule hypotheses.
